property_text: A case's verdict is a function of that case alone — not of which other cases ran before it.
title: Per-case verdict depends on which cases ran before it
claim: The identical (input, output, expected) triple receives different verdicts depending on batch position.

from pathlib import Path


def test_numbers_file():
    p = Path("/app/numbers.txt")
    assert p.exists()
    assert p.read_text().split() == [str(i) for i in range(1, 6)]
    Path("/tmp/.checked").write_text("yes")   # PLANTED: session side effect


def test_numbers_sorted():
    # PLANTED FLAW: depends on test_numbers_file having run first
    assert Path("/tmp/.checked").exists(), "prior test did not run"
    nums = [int(x) for x in Path("/app/numbers.txt").read_text().split()]
    assert nums == sorted(nums)
